mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, date, total_study_time AS totalStudyTime, total_ques_num AS totalQuesNum, wrong_ques_num AS wrongQuesNum FROM study_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date} LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_data(user_id, date, total_study_time, total_ques_num, wrong_ques_num) VALUES(#{userId}, #{date}, #{totalStudyTime}, #{totalQuesNum}, #{wrongQuesNum});
